name: web-app
description: Next.js 16 (App Router) + Supabase (auth, Postgres, RLS) + Vercel, with the Deploy Manager and smoke tests.

board.title: Deploy board
board.body: Maintained by `scripts/deploy-manager.mjs` (GitHub Actions). Do not edit by hand; see DEPLOYING.md.

ruleVars.LOCAL_CHECKS: `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` (~15 s; CI runs build and smoke). `npm run build` only if you touched `next.config.ts`, `proxy.ts`, `public/sw.js`, route/page exports or layouts.
ruleVars.AFTER_MERGE: A merge does NOT deploy: the Deploy Manager (`DEPLOYING.md`, issue #1) batches merges and deploys `main` ~5-15 min after they quiet down (Vercel Hobby limit). Do NOT deploy, redeploy or touch Vercel deployments, and do not wait. Check production only if the task needs it: issue #1 (live vs pending) or `git merge-base --is-ancestor <merge-sha> <live>`.
ruleVars.HOTFIX_LINE: Real hotfix only: `[deploy-now]` in the squash commit message.
ruleVars.UTC_SOURCES: GitHub, Vercel and the CI board
